errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: This page hit an error and could not be displayed. Reloading usually fixes it. If it keeps happening, copy the details below and include them in a bug report.
errorBoundary.chunkDescription: Part of the interface failed to load, which usually means Frigate was updated while this tab was open. Reload to pick up the new version.
